interventions.detail: trax/data/tf_inputs.py imports tf.estimator, removed in TF>=2.16; fall back to 'train'/'eval' ModeKeys strings
pin jax==jaxlib==0.7.2: jax 0.12 removed the jax_pmap_shmap_merge flag that trax/optimizers/trainer.py sets
install tensorflow explicitly (setup.py lists it only as an extra) and install trax from the repo so the patch applies

gs://trax-ml (ende_wmt32k.pkl.gz checkpoint and ende_32k.subword vocab) returns 403 to anonymous callers and no public mirror exists; the vocab can be swapped for the repo's testdata/vocab.translate_ende_wmt32k.32768.subwords, but the weights can't be replaced, so the snippet can't run
